business_profile.ownership_model: Private; venture-backed (investors include BGF, MMC Ventures, Unilever Ventures)
business_profile.mission_snippet: "We believe home cooking should be easy, tasty, and good for you" (Company website, About page).

operating_context.go_to_market_notes: Subscription and on-demand meal kit deliveries across Great Britain, Northern Ireland, and Republic of Ireland. Customer acquisition via digital marketing, partnerships, and trial discounts.
operating_model_insights: Recipe development and menu planning on 100+ weekly SKUs; heavy reliance on forecasting for perishable inventory.
Two highly automated production sites (Warrington, Clay Lake) orchestrated by Factory API services and PLC integrations (Source S3).
Centralised manufacturing and packing facilities ship insulated boxes via third-party logistics partners (e.g., Evri, Yodel).
Mobile app and web platform manage menu selection, order scheduling, and customer support, supported by proprietary subscription technology (Source S5).

pain_point_indicators.description: Customer complaints cite missing ingredients, ingredient freshness concerns, and late deliveries impacting experience.
Operational scaling challenges flagged in media; need current confirmation on workforce changes and cost-control initiatives.
pain_point_indicators.notes: Data gap – capture latest coverage on staffing and profitability push.

data_assets: Transactional order history and customer preferences (recipes chosen, ratings).
Ingredient supplier data, inventory levels, and cold-chain tracking.
Customer support interactions (chat, email) capturing service issues and sentiment.
operating_context.tech_stack_notes: Public job listings reference data engineering with Python, SQL, dbt; BI via Looker; infrastructure on AWS; experimentation platforms for personalisation. Factory API abstracts warehouse systems; in-house algorithms (Auto Replenish, Auto Routing, Pick Face Optimisation) drive fulfilment efficiency (Sources S3, S5).
regulatory_notes: Food safety compliance (UK Food Standards Agency, HACCP).
Sustainability reporting expectations for packaging and waste.

recent_headlines.summary: FY2024 revenue reached £312m with record adjusted EBITDA of £42m and <1% operational food waste; 2025 guidance targets 5–10% growth.
Automation investments at the Warrington site delivered 140% faster pack speeds and 99.97% pick accuracy, underpinning £26m underlying EBITDA in 2023.

operating_context.researcher_notes: Need verified FY2024 Companies House filings, courier SLA performance data, and insight into current next-day delivery trials.
